profile.headline: Software Engineer @ DoorDash | Building Scalable Notification Systems
profile.summary:
- Experienced in designing and implementing the large-scale web application using Java EE, Spring and Hibernate frameworks and collaborating in projects throughout the
complete software development life‑cycle, with advanced development methodologies. 
- Strong database skills with MySQL and MongoDB
- Experience in implementing Microservice architecture using Spring Boot, Kafka, Spring Cloud Netflix
- Worked with cloud services like AWS and Google Cloud
- Had experience in working with Kubernetes, Docker and CI systems like Jenkins and TravisCI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Working with the team on the DoorDash Notification Platform, designed to deliver the right message to the right user at the right time through the optimal channel.
- Contributed to the core services powering DoorDash-wide communications, helping ensure reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient notification delivery.
- Collaborated on the development of a multi-channel Preference Center, supporting notification preferences across diverse user types.
- Built internal tooling with the team to enable cross-functional groups to self-serve notification setup, improving onboarding speed and operational velocity.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-	Worked on the authentication platform utilizing various authentication techniques such as OAuth2, SSO, cert based authentication
-	Deployed authorization server to AWS using Cloud Formation and Service Catalogs utilizing several other services like EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, VPC, CloudHSM, ASM, KMS, SNS, Step Functions, etc.
-	Worked on DMZ WEB and APP tier gateway applications for authenticating external traffic and routing to internal services using Chef cookbooks, data bags, Apache, and Spring API gateways
-	Worked on the applications involving SOAP and REST APIs
-	Worked on Java spring-boot-based centralized cryptographic application for various microservices which is responsible for encryption, message signing, and tokenization for the sensitive data

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Involved in creating backend utilizing Java, Java EE, Enterprise Java Bean, Hibernate JPA with Spring framework
•	Worked on the micro-service architecture with Spring cloud and databases like MySQL and MongoDB
•	Experience in implementing companies various projects using own SSO oAuth2 platform 
•	Created number of REST APIs for frontend and mobile and used SSO and Spring Security for role management and API security
•	Worked on payment gateway integrations  such as Braintree, Authorize.net and Square
•	Used tools such as Elastic Search, Redis, Firebase, Spring Cloud Netflix, Kafka
•	Integrated CI/CD tools for easy deployment such as  Git, Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes
•	Applied quartz scheduler to configure tasks dynamically and created dynamic modules for customization
•	Wrote various JUnit tests and end to end integration tests using different roles authorizer 
•	Used AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, ECR, SES, SNS and code quality and coverage tools such as SonarQube, JaCoCo Analysis
•	Analysed and improved technical issues for application performance and stability
•	Had experience in managing sprint and offshore team in high work loads 
•	Closely work with product design team to create new features and made plan for successful implementation in tight deadlines.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
•	Working on an Android application with MVP architecture for reliable app development
•	Used various libraries and frameworks such as Dagger2, RetroFit, RxJava, ButterKnife and Realm for building scalable and reliable applications
•	Worked with various Android application test frameworks such as JUnit and InstrumentRunnerTest
•	Integrated various AWS services to connect mobile services to cloud
•	Configured apps with offline capabilities 
•	Created custom UI elements to unify whole app's UI/UX
•	Localized the whole application so it can work seamlessly with user's own language
•	Configured different flavors of the application so that it can behave differently on different environment
•	Involved with backend team to help them to fix the bugs in the backend

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Worked with group of students to develop 4 different Android applications.
•	Used Retrofit, ButterKnife, Firebase services such as Realtime database, Push notifications, Authentication using different social networks, crash reporting and Analytics.
•	Covered various android topics such as App responsiveness, localization, thread management and NDK
•	Used Slack and ZanHub for Agile product development.

positions.title: Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Maintained backend stack for course management functionality
•	Improved course recommendation algorithm based on the test given by the user
•	Migrated whole staging area to AWS
